content: Solid Queue persists a row in solid_queue_jobs containing the job class, queue and ALL serialized arguments as JSON in the database. ActiveRecord args become GlobalIDs; plain strings are stored verbatim. Guidance is to keep arguments small and load data inside the job. Consequence: any secret passed as a job argument (Evolution apikey, instance token, signed media URL) is written in cleartext to a DB table, survives in solid_queue_failed_executions after failure, and is echoed into exception reporters and Mission Control Jobs UI. Rails filter_parameters does NOT cover ActiveJob argument serialization.
